answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the vine of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the crystal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
